source: MG5_aMC 3.7.0 output standalone, SMATRIX in binary64 at the binary64 rounding of the points (tools/loop_reference/decay_tree_mg5.py)
normalization: summed over final helicities and colours, averaged over the decaying particle's helicities and colours, divided by the final identical-particle factor
